Job Title: GenAI / AI-ML Product Development Engineer




Location: Noida / Bangalore


Experience: 5+ Years


Notice Period: Immediate to 60 Days




Job Description

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Product Development professional to join a multidisciplinary team focused on rapidly experimenting, building, and validating innovative GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using agile methodologies.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and validate cutting-edge GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Work with multidisciplinary teams to rapidly prototype and productionize AI solutions.
Explore advanced AI models and proprietary generative AI models.
Apply software and AI architectural patterns to build scalable solutions.
Develop solutions using modern Agentic AI frameworks, protocols, and cloud platforms.
Contribute to end-to-end product development and technical solution design.
Provide technical consulting and collaborate with engineering and business stakeholders.



Mandatory Technical Skills

Programming Any 2:

Python
Java
JavaScript

Agentic AI / Frameworks & Protocols:

LangChain
CrewAI
Microsoft Copilot
Google AgentSpace
MCP
A2A

AI/ML GenAI Mandatory + Any 2:

Generative AI
Deep Learning
NLP
TensorFlow
PyTorch
Scikit-learn

Cloud / Platforms – Hands-on experience with any 2–3:

AWS
Azure
Google Cloud
ServiceNow
Salesforce

Additional Technical Skills:

Software architecture and architectural patterns
Kubernetes / Container Management
Bash Shell Scripting
Linux / Unix



Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in product development / software development.
BE/B.Tech or higher qualification in Computer Science or related streams.
Degree should be from premier institutes only.
Strong experience in AI/ML technologies and software development.
Hands-on experience developing cutting-edge GenAI solutions.
Excellent consulting and communication skills.
Strong programming expertise in Python / Java or relevant combination.
Experience working in agile, multidisciplinary teams with rapid experimentation and solution validation.



Preferred Notice Period: Immediate to 60 days




Key Skills: GenAI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI/ML, Python, Java, JavaScript, LangChain, CrewAI, MCP, A2A, Copilot, AgentSpace, NLP, Deep Learning, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Bash, Linux, Product Development
